title: SREV-114 SCM service key path shape

official_scm_shape.description: Official Win32 service name, SCM handle, and service registry key shape

official_registry_shape.description: Official object attributes and registry key open/create shape

source_change.description: Length-derived service registry path allocation and handle payload casing

runtime_matrix.description: Windows SCM and boxed-service registry path proof

contracts: OpenServiceW service names are non-empty and at most 256 characters
Sandboxie local service handles store a tzuk marker followed by the service-name payload
lower-casing applies only to the service-name payload and not to the marker
service registry paths are composed from Scm_ServicesKeyPath slash and service name
service registry path buffers are sized from actual base path and service name length
Scm_OpenKeyForService owns the temporary path buffer until NtOpenKey or NtCreateKey returns
Scm_DiscardKeyCache invalidates Services root and service subkey while preserving caller last error
this SREV must not change access masks boxed-service lookup SbieSvc query routing key-cache invalidation targets or handle marker layout
